Shiv Kumari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117209356/
1

 Court No. - 77
 Hon'Ble Saurabh Srivastava, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for applicant and learned Aga appearing for the State.
2.

This present application has been filed for seeking quashing of chargesheet dated 24.12.2016 along with cognizance order dated 27.09.2017 and entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.4847 of 2017 (State Vs. Muniya and others and others), arising out of Case Crime No.810 of 2015, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406 IPC, P.S. Haldharpur, District Mau, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mau.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.4847 of 2017 (State Vs. Muniya and others and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. On perusal of the narration of FIR as well as impugned order and chargesheet, this Court does not find it to be a case where interference of this Court is required.
No such ground appears to be available in the present application, on the basis of which, impugned order along with chargesheet and entire proceedings of the said case, can be set aside.
4. Accordingly, the prayer sought through the instant application, is refused.
5. Lastly, learned counsel for applicant has submitted that liberty may be granted to applicant to surrender before the court concerned and apply for bail to which learned AGA has no objection.

6. In view of the aforesaid, the instant application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned that in case, the applicant surrenders before the court concerned within a period of 15 days from today and applies for bail, her bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another (2022 SCC OnLine SC 825).
7.

sentences.text: However, it is made clear that till 15 days from today, no coercive action shall be taken against applicant herein in pursuance of aforesaid case.

(Saurabh Srivastava,J.) November 6, 2025 Vivek Kr.
